recommendations.name: Linear point-grid construction
recommendations.implementation: Build scalar next links and bucket heads in a private pass, then generate nominal Point records once. Preserve source order, collision chains, range validation, persistent snapshots and hash buckets. A direct rewrite constructing each whole Point before assignment did not remove the copying.

recommendations.name: Bulk relationship target removal
recommendations.implementation: Collect incoming source IDs, remove their forward edges through map.remove_many, and remove the inverse bucket once. Keep other targets, equivalent-key policies and old snapshots unchanged. Consider grouped link/unlink batches separately.

recommendations.name: Use grouped maps in set operations
recommendations.implementation: Construct sets with map.from over (key, Unit) pairs, and use grouped edits for union/difference. Preserve representative keys and deterministic enumeration; qualify collisions and tiny inputs. Only construction is measured here.

recommendations.name: Adaptive ECS bit iteration
recommendations.implementation: Count bits directly and iterate only set bits for sparse masks. Preserve the simple dense loop where it wins; expand to other iteration helpers only after measuring real value fetches. Full-mask control loses under unconditional set-bit iteration.

recommendations.name: Incremental ECS membership metadata
recommendations.implementation: edit_selected currently copies all mask words and rescans all words to rebuild occupied even for payload-only edits. Retain occupied when no word crosses zero, merge only crossing words when membership changes, and evaluate paged masks for genuinely sparse metadata writes. Preserve sorted membership, generations and snapshots.

recommendations.name: Run prepared-physics character movement once
recommendations.implementation: Factor controller movement into an explicit prepared result containing shifted proxies, origins, velocities, pushes and walker outcomes. Use that result to select nearby fixed geometry and feed the solver instead of running character.move_queries in both preview and simulate_queries. Keep current full replay cases, platform carry, wake propagation and U32 IDs exact.

languageRecommendations: Qualify uniqueness for a fresh array of nominal scalar records through the actual point-grid loop. The existing indexed write reports copy_required/nonexclusive_predecessor; a scalar links pass avoids that array edit and scales approximately linearly.
Provide or recognize efficient scalar population-count and trailing-zero operations for bitset iteration, while retaining a measured dense path.
Investigate the new compiler queue regression before treating that binary as a replacement for the currently qualified toolchain.

import * as check from "checks/check"
import * as jobs from "ink/task_queue"

entry const test_generated_chunks = fn () => check.report #[check.words #[0,1,2,3,4,5] (flatten (array.generate 3 (fn i => #[i * 2, i * 2 + 1])))]

  let words = jobs.encode (fn i => #[i]) (fn i => #[i]) (fn i => #[i]) q
  return check.report #[check.words #[1,1,1,4,1,0,0] words]

  let q: jobs.Queue [U32,U32,U32] = jobs.make 1 4 #False

compilerRegression.conclusion: Two queue checks trap with the newer compiler under either standard library; all five pass under the frozen compiler/stdlib. Simple flatten and one-job encode checks pass with the new compiler and std. Root cause is not yet reduced; these observations do not identify array.flatten as the cause.

validation.independentWitnesses: Rust checks bucket heads and point links, set membership, relationship deletion outputs, sparse/dense entity indices and broad radius outputs. Complete pair outputs are compared outside timing. All warm replay capacities remain stable.

limits: These are isolated prototypes, not shipping implementations or gdev frame-time measurements. The last passing compiler and standard library are used for all timings.

Timings include fixture construction, guest execution and complete result decoding. Nearby host activity or clock changes affected absolute times; alternating pairs reduce that effect but do not remove all noise.

Point-grid build includes all head and Point fields in the witness. Its radius collector-only prototype improved just 6-13 percent including the expensive unchanged build and is not selected as a separate recommendation.
Relationship timings include constructing a star plus one unrelated edge, deleting the shared target, and inspecting the retained snapshot. General link/unlink batching is not measured.
Set construction uses unique U32 keys under the ordinary hash policy. Collision policies, repeated representatives and tiny batches need qualification before adopting the prototype.
Sparse ECS index fixture has one live bit per occupied 32-bit word. Dense control has all 32. It measures index collection, not component value access or full systems.
ECS metadata and physics movement reuse are source-backed recommendations without measured speedup claims.
The new compiler regression is documented and reproduced but not fixed; no sibling source or compiler configuration was changed.
reproduce: Restore prototype and runner into an isolated Ink checkout as .cache/next-review/prototypes.blot and tools/native/examples/qualify_more_review.rs, with the compiler/std hashes above; run cargo run --manifest-path tools/native/Cargo.toml --example qualify_more_review. The runner checks independent witnesses and writes .cache/next-review/paired.json.
